name: atelier-config-module
description: Atelier Config — the instance's settings panel: atelier.config.json edited as a form or raw JSON (validated, patch-merged, conflict-safe), apps & workspaces managed by drag-and-drop (link/unlink path-mounts, create/rename/delete workspaces), a pending-restart tracker with one-click self-restart, start-at-login via a macOS LaunchAgent (with the one-time port takeover from a dev server), Tailnet sharing of the instance's listeners via tailscale serve, Cloudflare-tunnel status & daemon control, live server output, and a package-manager system check. Ported from the marketplace dock's Configure surface.
author: pa1nd

atelier.note: Pure Node builtins, no deps. The General / Apps & Workspaces / Activity / System tabs work anywhere Atelier runs; the Start-at-login, Tailnet-sharing, and Cloudflare-tunnel tabs use macOS launchd / the tailscale and cloudflared CLIs and report themselves unsupported elsewhere. Config writes are atomic (tmp + rename), shape-validated, and patch-merged so a concurrent edit is never clobbered — a drifted key rejects with a conflict instead. The Activity tab tees this server process's stdout/stderr into a ring buffer; nothing is written to disk. Tunnel descriptors are per-machine state in data/tunnels.json (created by you; starts empty).
